indications_and_usage: Uses: For personal hand hygiene to help prevent the spread of bacteria.
warnings: Warnings For external use only. Do not use in eyes. If this occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation or redness develops and persists for more than 72 hours. Keep out of reach of children. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
